steps.content: There's a huge gap in strength between the two. In just a split second, Garofano gets knocked down, and a heavy shield pins her to the ground, immobilizing her.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: Ahhh... cough cough, what brute force... Are you a monster? What evil have you done to gain such strength?

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: Does your dear FAC know?

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: Who is the person directing you?

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: You call her family, so you must be very close. If I capture you, will she come looking for you?

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: ...What do you want to do?
Her voice turns cold.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: I want to go to Paradeisos. To do that, I need an opportunity to present them with a gift. You and your master will make the perfect gift.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: There are those in Paradeisos who want you guys. Did you know about that?

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: ...I see. So I'm not the only one you want...

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: Come now. Either 'fess up on your own, or wait for your "family" to come rescue you. You choose.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: Didn't you say she's a savior for revenge-seekers? Then she will definitely come find you.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: Hehehe... In that case, you have quite the potential to be an evildoer... Stop fretting over your so-called justice. You're already unfit to work for the FAC.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: Answer my questions! I have no patience with my enemies.
The heavy shield slams down again with bone-cracking force. Garofano groans in pain, yet wears a weak and intoxicated smile. There is no more kindly enticement in her eyes, only hostility and malice.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: Hehehe, you've waited for ten years already. Why the rush now?

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: I gave you that floral letter quite a while ago... Did you read it? Did you not understand it?

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: Just straight-up tell me what's in it. I don't want to play more riddle games with you.
Rahu frowns and exerts more force, but the assassin's body is as soft as water, absorbing all the force like a sponge. Her smile widens, sending a chill down Rahu's spine.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: It's quite simple. Let me take you through it step by step.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: This is the <color=#fb9259>secret comms code</color>, the only code that penetrated the DisSea's Black Ring during the Eclipse Operation. It was used to send you orders inside the Ring. It came from the elusive Paradeisos.

As she babbles leisurely, she suddenly tugs on a faint silk thread on the ground nearby, triggering a mechanism on the wall. Several needles labeled with strange runes shoot out. Rahu refuses to let go of her shield, and the needles pierce deeply into her upper arm.

This time, the needles aren't covered with neurotoxins, but something... filthier and deadlier. It penetrates Rahu's consciousness like a living organism. Her vision gradually turns red, and the voice of the enemy becomes distant.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: Recognize it? The other end of this comms is the enemy you've failed to find in your ten-year search of DisCity.
Rahu can't feel the pain. That nightmarish string of numbers occupies her entire brain, igniting the boiling Mania in her body. At the same time, it awakens a dormant, painful memory.

steps.speaker: Vague Voice
steps.content: The DisSea tide is rising ahead of schedule! We can't hold out with this temporary line of defense! Requesting to retreat!! We must retreat!!

steps.speaker: Vague Voice
steps.content: No word from Paradeisos yet?! What about the comms? Didn't they say they have a way to contact us through the Black Ring?
<color=#fb9259>05257885</color>: Obstructions cleared, <color=#fb9259>Super-loop Observation Anchor</color> established, Mania noise filtered out, connection stabilized.

<color=#fb9259>05257885</color>: Greetings, FAC personnel of Eclipse Operation. I am your Paradeisos observer and liaison officer. We have completed data collection and battlefield analysis, and our decision is—<color=#fb9259>the mission shall continue</color>.

<color=#fb9259>05257885</color>: There is only one goal: do your best to withstand DisSea's rising tide before the task is complete. I will assist you in redeployment. Calculated based on the relative time inside the Ring, the remaining forces can withstand for another 34 minutes.
...You again...

<color=#fb9259>05257885</color>: I understand that everyone's mental state has reached the breaking point, so I also bring some good news.

<color=#fb9259>05257885</color>: Rescue forces have gone deep into DisSea. Hang on for a bit longer. As long as you withstand the tide and extend the window for 44 minutes, they will reach the temporary levee.

<color=#fb9259>05257885</color>: All right, brace yourselves. You are in a place where determination can alter reality. You are the staunchest and bravest people in all of DisCity.

<color=#fb9259>05257885</color>: You can do it.
...Lies... We held out for three hours... No help ever came...
You lied to us, and left us to die...
<color=#fb9259>05257885</color>: This operation is of great significance, and we can only rely on the FAC. Paradeisos conveys to you our utmost respect.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: You let them die there for no reason!!

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: All worked up? Who are you shouting at?
Tsss...!
A sharp object pierces Rahu's collarbone. Thanks to the excruciating pain, she finally struggles free from the hallucinations, forcing open her eyes and returning to reality.
She's in the tailor shop, not in the DisSea of ten years ago. The person in front of her is the assassin, not the blood-stained number she's pursuing.

Garofano had already slipped away from the heavy shield. She is still smiling, weakly but triumphantly, as she slowly spins the needle piercing Rahu, sending the poison and contamination deeper into her body.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: I didn't want to use this on you. You had an intense reaction. Did you see the enemy you've been thinking about all these years?

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: ...Where did you get this code? How come you know so much?
This code is the only clue that Rahu has about that person. She memorized it and searched for ten years, but never saw anything outside of her nightmares.
Yet now this woman easily dishes out her deepest secret, and knows more about this number than the "sole survivor" herself.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: Could it be that... you were there, too? In DisSea? Or... Paradeisos?

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: You've seen <color=#fb9259>that person</color>?

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: Who is he? Where is he now?!

She wants to grab the assassin, who stabs her with another needle. Rahu's body goes numb. The poison spreads to every corner of her body, slowing down her movements and making it impossible for her to keep up with the enemy.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: What's the rush? Can't you see I'm about to tell you?

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: I did some dirty work for Mania traffickers in exchange for information. I know they're bastards, but I don't care.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: Only the shadiest bastards can get to the shady truth. They can tear open the facade of Paradeisos and give those hot shots something to worry about.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: Can ordinary folks like you and me do that?
Tsss! Another needle pierces Rahu's other shoulder. The poison and Mania erode deeper, ferociously tormenting the soldier who is on the verge of going manic.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: I know my hands are dirty. I know that some of the Paradeisos people I attacked are innocent... but they've all been useful.
She fishes out a third needle, but doesn't rush to stab Rahu. She slowly traces Rahu's chest with the needle tip, as if probing the heart of the prey.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: Those Paradeisos f***** have always been secretive. Outsiders don't even know where Paradeisos is. But recently, several of their people have parachuted into Eastside.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: They visited Nirvana, the FAC, the City Council... lots of places. You and I both know they're here to fix the mess in West District. There's no question that they're important.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: So we're both here to seize upon this rare chance, to use them to learn about and infiltrate Paradeisos.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: You forced your way into this protective mission, trying to gain her trust. How "upright" of you, FAC soldier.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: But no matter how hard you try, those nobles won't take their dog back to Paradeisos. To get information from those bastards, this is what you have to do...
Garofano tears open the front of Rahu's coat with the needle tip, revealing the flowery scroll inside the pocket. She takes it out.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: This is a <color=#fb9259>notice letter</color>, sent to every Paradeisos person on my hunting list in advance. They're smart and know at first glance that it's not a death threat, but a <color=#fb9259>lifeline</color>.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: The puzzles aren't difficult. They all know what I want, and will tell me if they want to live. I've clearly laid out the deal: Give me the information, and I'll spare your life. Can you guess if they told me or not?

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: There are bound to be those who don't know anything, and there are also many innocent people around them. But you didn't spare them either...

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: That's right! Isn't this the <color=#fb9259>necessary sacrifice</color>? They will surely understand. It's the only way to fully appreciate the gravity of this <color=#fb9259>opportunity</color>. There are bound to be those who will spill the beans, and some already have.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: This is the right way to use this opportunity. This is true revenge. I'm willing to give up everything and burn in hell. What about you, the upright FAC?

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: It's been ten years. What have you accomplished aside from acquiring your power and getting close to a useless Paradeisos woman?
The toxins magnify the shock and confusion in Rahu's heart. She pants heavily, both from pain and excitement, and starts laughing.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: Ha... hahaha... there's still you, isn't there?

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: I don't need to betray the FAC. I can just rip open your mouth and get everything I want!

Her smoldering Mania suddenly erupts. Roaring, Rahu leaps up and sprints forth with the needles still protruding from her. She grabs Garofano by the neck and rams her into the wall with all her strength.
Almost simultaneously, the sheer force of her Mania triggers the alarm. The harsh sirens ring throughout the villa, and someone fires a shot.

steps.speaker: Security Chief
steps.content: Sinner!! Let go of that woman! You've lost control already! Stop right now!!!

steps.speaker: Security Chief
steps.content: If you don't surrender, we'll shoot!
The sniper bullet pierces through the window and whizzes towards Rahu's temple. She instinctively blocks it with her shield, loosening her grip on the enemy.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: Ha... Hahahaha... What amazing power... Your Mania even triggered the alarm. They'll treat you like a monster now.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: Will the FAC still want you the way you are now? Will they kill you? Hahaha...

With her last bit of strength, she reaches out to touch Rahu's cheek and peels off her mask. Bright red Mania burn marks sear the soldier's face in an instant. Rahu roars, lets go of her and stumbles backward, covering her face.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: I've long completed my revenge. Somebody put an end to my hatred, soothing the rage and emptiness in my heart. I have a new family, a new life. I've received salvation.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: I wanted to bring you back too, but it seems that not all exploited souls can become family... You make me cherish the only treasure I have even more...

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: I won't let anyone hurt my possessions again. I won't spare you, or the people you want to use us to please.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: I gave up everything to seek revenge, and now, I will double down on defending my future. How can you, who have nothing, win against me? You're an abandoned dog that does nothing but bark blindly.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: Come out!!!
Rahu roars and tries to break through the invisible vortex of madness to find her enemy. But more bullets pelt the dilapidated house, and Mania sweeps through her body.
She can no longer find her way back. Only the woman's delicate voice lingers in her ears.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: Go ahead and wallow in the past with your stubbornness.
